objective: Test one sparse multi-granular segment router that combines V43-style unordered BPE evidence with hashed character phrase evidence while retaining V44's explicit metadata rejection and segment selection.
causal_basis: V43 generalized at 95.36% body accuracy but lacked phrase/order evidence for coherence and fact-free reasoning. V44 proved metadata rejection at 100% but its max-pooled convolution regressed body accuracy to 86.07%. Their oracle union still leaves coherence at 72%, prohibiting a fusion. V45 uses a log-linear representation with both robust unigram and phrase evidence rather than another dense sequence encoder.

representation.character_normalization: Unicode casefold plus whitespace collapse plus explicit boundaries
representation.fusion: sum of mean-pooled class logits plus bias

segmentation.rule: When a prompt contains multiple lines, classify the first line and the unchanged remaining text as separate semantic segments; otherwise classify the entire prompt as one segment.
segmentation.selection: Exclude segments predicted as metadata, then select the remaining segment with the greatest capability probability. If every segment is predicted metadata, fail-soft to the segment with the greatest capability probability.

supervision.capability_view: unchanged acquisition body with its existing Phase 1 capability label
supervision.metadata_view: unchanged acquisition first line with a metadata label derived only from the pre-existing prompt boundary

decision_rule: Run only R0 seed 240045. A full pass of aggregate original, aggregate body, every original-prompt capability, and metadata rejection may authorize exactly two locked replication seeds. Any miss closes V45 and prohibits replications and a routed LayerCake host.
claim_boundary: Standalone ABI router gate only; not English generation, Phase 3 certification, LayerCake quality, or ABI superiority.
